blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the South Surrey and White Rock total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Pacific Douglas rose from 30 in June to 39 in September (+30.0%), and 13 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 6.5% of South Surrey and White Rock’s 600 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Pacific Douglas?
Pacific Douglas also had 25 condos and townhomes listed and 4 sold in September, against 39 houses listed. The Pacific Douglas condos and townhomes page has those figures.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Pacific Douglas?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 39 houses listed in Pacific Douglas. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Pacific Douglas a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses in Pacific Douglas had a sales ratio of 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Pacific Douglas from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 13 houses sold in Pacific Douglas over those 4 months, out of 240 in all of South Surrey and White Rock.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Pacific Douglas?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.
